newsitem.title: USA: J.C.Penney to launch new ad campaign.
newsitem.headline: J.C.Penney to launch new ad campaign.

text.p: J.C. Penney Co Inc said Wednesday it will launch a new marketing campaign on March 12, with the theme "JCPenney, I Love Your Style."

Television spots of 60 and 30 seconds will launch the campaign during its seven-week introductory phase, which includes the Academy Awards broadcast on March 24. In addition, newspaper circulars, direct mail, and in-store signage will carry the new themeline.
The campaign, created by Temerlin-McLain, JCPenney's Dallas-based advertising agency, is aimed at JCPenney shoppers, women aged 25-54 who have children and are employed outside the home.
